headline: British baby thrives after pioneering womb surgery
summary: Theo was treated at 26 weeks in a clinical trial after doctors found complex gastroschisis; he was born in Texas and is now thriving at five months.
script: Baby Theo is thriving after surgeons in Texas repaired complex gastroschisis before birth. At 26 weeks, they used keyhole surgery to move his intestines back inside the womb. The British family later returned home after a successful delivery.
